dedupe_keys.name: sp enw lct low carbon technology readiness checker

description: SP ENW - LCT - Low Carbon Technology Readiness Checker is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - LCT - Low Carbon Technology Readiness Checker Dataset utilising our GIS information to depict the potential suitability of a property adopting new Low Carbon Technology (LCT) This initial assessment tool assesses how a property meets with a series of 'LCT Checkers', which will indicate its potential suitability for ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Capacity Data. Its keywords are LCT, Readiness, Checker, Domestic Customer Persona, Local Authority Persona 1, Local Authority Persona 2. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
